name: Financial Instrument Quantity 32 Choice
definition: Defines the format for the quantity of security.

Unit.name: Unit
Unit.definition: Quantity expressed as a number, such as a number of shares.

NominalValue.name: Nominal Value
NominalValue.definition: Indicates that quantity is expressed as a nominal value.

MonetaryValue.name: Monetary Value
MonetaryValue.definition: Indicates that quantity is expressed as a monetary value.
